subject.title: Feature: Expose OpenRouter usage cost to agent runtime

question: Should agent-facing usage expose provider-reported OpenRouter charges as separate source-tagged values, and should that contract cover live per-turn state, durable session metadata, or both?
rationale: Current main intentionally exposes estimated USD cost while OpenRouter supplies provider-reported charges that may be reconciled after streaming, so naming, units, fallback, aggregation, and durability require maintainer intent.

options.title: Expose both exact and estimated
options.body: Add source and unit metadata with exact per-call and per-turn provider cost plus the existing estimate fallback across live and durable usage surfaces.

options.title: Expose exact cost live only
options.body: Add provider cost to live per-turn usage state while deferring durable session-schema expansion to the broader usage API design.

options.title: Keep estimates canonical
options.body: Retain estimated agent-facing costs and reserve authoritative provider charges for provider-account or transcript-analysis surfaces.

recommendation.title: Expose both exact and estimated
recommendation.body: Add source and unit metadata with exact per-call and per-turn provider cost plus the existing estimate fallback across live and durable usage surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: The authoritative OpenRouter charge currently enters OpenClaw through the provider reconciliation path this person introduced.
